name: comp-181

frames.best_why: Interface is off with a moon icon while the rows below show suns, so both icons appear together.

tagline: Switches swap a tiny sun for a moon as they turn on and off.
summary: A switch with a small sun or crescent moon beside it that follows the switch state, shown three times in an Appearance card of theme rows. The knob slides and the icon swaps in the same motion.
appearance: A dark rounded card titled Appearance holds a grey subtitle and three rows split by faint rules. Each row puts a bold name and a grey description on the left and a small pill switch with a 16px sun or crescent on the right.
behaviour: Clicking a switch slides its knob to the other end, darkens the track when off and replaces the sun with a crescent moon. The clip flips Interface, then Code blocks, and each switch is independent.
demo_content: Appearance card with Interface, Code blocks and Emails rows and their helper lines
search_phrases: toggle with sun and moon icons
dark mode switch with an icon
switch showing a sun when on
turn dark theme on and off
use_when: For a light and dark mode setting, when a sun or moon should show the live state beside the switch.
avoid_when: The meaning sits in the icon, so reusing it for an unrelated setting leaves the switch ambiguous.
customise: The sun and moon imports, the starting state and the switch size are written in the file, and it takes no props. Edit the icons or the default there; the card and rows are demo code.
weight_why: One native switch with a sliding knob and a single icon that swaps.

a11y.note: The sun and moon are hidden from assistive tech and the switch is named only Toggle switch, so the icon state has no spoken equivalent.

issues: The switch is named Toggle switch, so a row's own title never reaches the control.
State is carried by the sun and moon, which a sighted user has to decode.
polish_why: Even rows and a neat icon swap; the switch is standard and the meaning rests on the icons.
